question_en: What did American Electric Power change in its bylaws in April 2023, and who signed off on it?
question_vi: American Electric Power đã thay đổi điều gì trong điều lệ công ty vào tháng 4 năm 2023, và ai đã thông qua?
reference_answer: Effective April 25, 2023, the Board of Directors and shareholders of American Electric Power amended the Company's Bylaws to eliminate the supermajority voting provisions.
evidence_quotes: Effective April 25, 2023, the Board of Directors (the "Board") and shareholders of American Electric Power Company, Inc. (the “Company”) amended the Company’s Bylaws to eliminate the supermajority voting provisions.

question_en: Paychex's equity pay expense went up in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 versus the first quarter of fiscal 2026, right? How big was the jump?
question_vi: Chi phí thưởng cổ phiếu cho nhân viên của Paychex trong quý 1 năm tài chính 2027 tăng so với quý 1 năm tài chính 2026 đúng không? Tăng bao nhiêu?
reference_answer: No, it did not rise. Paychex's stock-based compensation costs fell 28.0%, from $26.8 million for the three months ended August 31, 2025 to $19.3 million for the three months ended August 31, 2026.
evidence_quotes: Stock-based compensation costs recognized were $19.3 million for the three months ended August 31, 2026, compared with $26.8 million for the three months ended August 31, 2025.

question_en: In the executive officers list of PPL's 10-K filed in February 2025, what job did Tadd Henninger hold before he became senior VP of finance and treasurer, and for how long?

reference_answer: Tadd J. Henninger was Vice President-Finance and Treasurer from July 2019 to January 2023, and has been Senior Vice President-Finance and Treasurer since January 2023.

question_en: In their fiscal Q2 2027 10-Qs, what do CRWD and NVDA each say about their gross margin?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-Q quý 2 năm tài chính 2027, CRWD và NVDA mỗi bên nói gì về biên lợi nhuận gộp của mình?
reference_answer: CrowdStrike expects gross profit to increase in dollar amount and gross margin to increase modestly over the long term, though margin could fluctuate period to period. NVIDIA says inventory provisions net of releases had an unfavorable 0.8% impact on gross margin in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (1.0% for the first half).
evidence_quotes: We expect our gross profit to increase in dollar amount and our gross margin to increase modestly over the long term as we grow our business, although our gross margin could fluctuate from period to period depending on the interplay of these factors.
The net effect on our gross margin was an unfavorable impact of 0.8% and 1.0% in the second quarter and first half of fiscal year 2027, respectively.

question_vi: Trong phần Business của báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2021, công ty nào trong số Warner Bros. Discovery, AT&T, Disney và AppLovin có nhắc đến COVID-19?
reference_answer: Warner Bros. Discovery (then Discovery, Inc.): yes. AT&T: yes. Disney: yes. AppLovin: no.
evidence_quotes: We will continue to monitor COVID-19 and its impact on our business results and financial condition.

question_en: What was KO's profit margin in Q3 2022, using bottom-line profit attributable to its own shareholders over revenue?
question_vi: Biên lợi nhuận ròng của KO trong quý 3 năm 2022 là bao nhiêu, tính theo lợi nhuận thuộc về cổ đông công ty trên doanh thu?
reference_answer: KO's net margin was 25.5% in Q3 2022: net income attributable to shareowners of $2,825 million on net operating revenues of $11,063 million for the three months ended September 30, 2022.
